description: Get the FULL TEXT of a section of the Maryland Code — Maryland state statutes — by citation. "Md. Code, Criminal Law 2-201" is first degree murder. Returns the statutory text. Keyless. Use for "what does Maryland Criminal Law 2-201 say" or to check a Maryland statute a case relies on.

article.description: Maryland article name, e.g. "Criminal Law", "Transportation", "Family Law". Call md_articles for the list.
